snippet.title: GREY CAT - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Doom World: https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/158448-mbf21-dsdhacked-grey-cat-released-rc-1/
Doom Power: https://i.iddqd.ru/viewtopic.php?t=2867

In this community project, participants take on roles both in creating layouts and in detailing layouts provided to mappers. A map can be created in any style-the main goal is to transform the original layout beyond recognition.

The goal of this project is to teach mappers not only how to create well-designed and engaging layouts, but also how to effectively detail maps based on those layouts-one of the key fundamentals
of level design.

OST: Hell's Jungle from Serious Sam Siberian Mayhem by Damjan Mravunac (original), Ivan "Spelljack" Jitz, Anna Lazarev. (Arrangement)
